periodo: Figures are grouped by calendar year, month or week, using Madrid time. The range includes each complete period that intersects the selected dates.
ambito: Only requests within the organisation, centre or unit that your profile may consult are counted.
corte: Figures cover the latest snapshot published for HR. Changes that have not yet been published are excluded.
calidad: Counts describe the published versions of requests. They do not by themselves establish a signature, the start of service or other administrative effects.
gobierno: The institutional owner has yet to be assigned, and these definitions await approval.

altas.definicion: Counts each request once, in the period of its earliest creation date.

llamamientos.definicion: Counts each request once, in the period of its first version in the candidate call phase.

formalizaciones.definicion: Counts each request once when it first reaches the appointment phase. This does not establish a signature or an effective appointment.

cierres.definicion: Counts each request once, in the period of its first completed or cancelled version.

incidencias.definicion: Counts each entry into the issue status. A request may count more than once if it leaves that status and later returns.

consulta_pendiente: There is no compatible query response yet to link these definitions to a data snapshot.
consulta_incompatible: The query response does not match the format or snapshot described by this sheet.
